name: Strait Gate
overview: The Scripture teaches that entering the strait gate is essential for true life, emphasizing that the gate is narrow and the way is difficult, contrasting with the broad path leading to destruction that many follow. Jesus commands believers to strive to enter through this narrow gate, acknowledging that while many will attempt, few will succeed. This calls for intentional, earnest effort to follow Christ's path, recognizing the exclusivity and challenge of salvation.
